files.rationale: Add tailwindcss, postcss, and autoprefixer as devDependencies -- they were referenced by tailwind.config.js/postcss.config.cjs but never actually declared or installed, so Tailwind was never really running.
A leftover deprecated stub (kept alongside the real postcss.config.cjs) was still being picked up by Vite ahead of the real config, resulting in zero PostCSS plugins running at all.

summary: Fix: Tailwind CSS never actually applied because (1) tailwindcss/postcss/autoprefixer were never declared as npm dependencies despite config files referencing them, and (2) a stale postcss.config.js stub was shadowing the real postcss.config.cjs in Vite's config resolution, resulting in zero PostCSS plugins running. Added the missing dependencies and removed the stale config file. Verified: built CSS grew from 136 bytes of raw unprocessed @tailwind directives to 12.86kB of real utility CSS; a real browser screenshot confirms visible Tailwind styling.
